journal_lines: Found a clearing. The trees lean inward around it.
Mushrooms growing up the trunks, not just the ground.
Long claw marks on the trunk. Higher than I wanted to think.
The inside of the dark oak was pale. Did not expect that.
The mushrooms here are large enough to shelter under.
Nothing in the dark forest makes casual noise.
The dark oak is hard to the axe. The grain fights back.
Light doesn't reach the floor without a long drop.
The old growth dark oak took three times longer to fell.
The trunk split clean but fell wrong. Worked around it.
Something left bones in a clearing. Arranged.
No birdsong in here. Just the wind in the high branches.
Mushroom cap six feet across. Worked around it.
The silence had a quality to it. Present and attentive.
Found a mansion in the trees. Did not approach.
